transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because... things have just been a lot lately. Ever since my sister and her baby moved back home, I’ve been feeling a lot more on edge and down than usual. I find myself snapping over little stuff at the house, which isn't really like me. 

And then, you know, I show up to my classes or the shop where I work, and I'm just already drained before the day even starts. I'm still getting by, for the most part, but I’ve missed a couple of deadlines for school. I even had to back out of helping build the set for the theater production because I just couldn’t keep everything straight in my head. It's just... it's been overwhelming.
Are you still enjoying the things you used to like doing?

Yeah, I think so. I mean, I still like doing the same stuff I always have. It's not like I don't care about my hobbies or anything anymore. It's just... like I was saying, I'm so drained that it's harder to actually find the energy to get up and go do them. But when I'm actually doing something I like, yeah, I still enjoy it.
Do you feel like you're getting as much pleasure from your hobbies as you used to?

Yeah, I'd say I get the same amount of pleasure from them. It's just... I guess the hard part is just getting started, you know? Like, once I'm actually doing it, I'm fine. I still like it just as much. It's just finding the energy to actually start that's the problem right now.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been going on for about a month now. Basically, it started right when my sister and her baby moved back into the house.
Have you been experiencing any feelings of worry or fear that you couldn't control?
No, not really. I mean, I get stressed out about the house being so crowded and loud now, but I wouldn't say I'm worried or scared of anything. It's definitely nothing out of control like that.
Have you been experiencing any changes in your appetite or sleep patterns?
No, not really. I'm still eating pretty much the same as I always do. And my sleep... I mean, my sleep is fine. I haven't noticed any real changes with either of those.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I get frustrated with how crowded the house is now, but I wouldn't say I feel sad. I'm definitely not walking around feeling sad all day.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now don't find pleasurable?

No, I still like doing the things I usually do. I mean, I still enjoy working on engines and hanging out when I get the chance. I haven't really lost interest in any of my normal hobbies or anything like that.
Have you had any days where you felt like you couldn't get out of bed or do anything at all?
No, I haven't had any days like that. I get up and go to work just fine. I mean, I might not always want to go, but I never feel like I physically can't get out of bed or anything.
Are there any activities that you used to think about or look forward to, but now you don't?

No, not really. I mean, I still look forward to the weekend or messing around with my car. Nothing's really changed there. I just get annoyed when I come home and there's no space to even think, but I still look forward to the stuff I usually like doing.
Have you noticed yourself wanting to do fewer things than you used to?
No, I wouldn't say that. I still do the same amount of stuff I always have. I mean, I still go to work, still work on my car, still hang out. I haven't really cut back on anything I want to do.
Do you feel like it takes more effort than usual to find pleasure in the things you enjoy?
No, I wouldn't say so. When I'm working on the car or just hanging out, it's still fun. I don't really have to force myself to enjoy it or anything. It's just the same as it always was.
Do you feel like your current state is interfering with your relationships or daily life?

A little bit, yeah. I mean, I’m still going to class and showing up to work, so I'm getting by. But I have turned in a couple of assignments late recently. And I actually had to drop this community theater set project I was helping build. I just couldn't keep up with everything, so I had to let that go.
Do you feel like you have to push yourself to feel happy when doing things you normally enjoy?
No, not really. I think it's pretty much like I was saying a minute ago. When I'm doing stuff I like, I just enjoy it. I don't have to fake it or push myself to feel good about it.
Would you say your feelings of being drained and overwhelmed are mild or more significant?

I'd say they're pretty mild. I mean, like I was saying, I'm still making it to work and going to my classes, so it's not completely stopping me from doing what I need to do. It's just a bit much sometimes, but yeah, I'd definitely call it mild.
Would you say your feelings of being drained and overwhelmed have been consistently present throughout the day?

No, I wouldn't say it's constant. Um... it's not really an all-day thing. It kind of comes and goes, I guess. Like, I'll be fine while I'm working or in class, but then I'll just feel it later on when I think about everything I have to do. So, no, definitely not all the time.
How long have you been feeling drained and overwhelmed since your sister and her baby moved back home?
Um, it's been about a month. That's when my sister and her baby moved back into the house, so... yeah, pretty much for the last month.
Would you say your feelings of being drained and overwhelmed are affecting your daily life in a significant way?

Not in a huge way, no. Like I mentioned, I’m still going to class and work just fine. But... well, I have turned in a couple of assignments late recently. And I actually had to drop this community theater set project I was helping build. I just couldn't keep up with everything all at once, so I had to let that go. So it's affecting things a little bit, just not completely stopping me.
Have your feelings of being drained and overwhelmed lasted for at least two weeks?
Yeah, definitely. Like I said, it started about a month ago when they moved in, so it's been going on for longer than two weeks.
